title: Ultra-broadband low-frequency high-efficiency acoustic energy harvesting with metamaterial-enhanced loudspeakers
readingDepth: Primary PDF retrieved from NSF public-access repository; printed pages 073903-1 to -5 read, including equations 1-21 and experimental method. Supplement not read.
claim: A passive electrodynamic receiver and acoustic matching structure convert incident acoustic power; losses and load affect conversion separately from absorption.
limits: Reported hardware not reproduced. The source's RMS wording alongside factors 1/2 requires an explicit amplitude convention. Its performance is not a prediction for our apparatus.
section: Printed pp. 1-5; equations 7-12, 20; experimental tube schematic Fig. 4

title: Wireless acoustic energy harvesting through an air-water metasurface with dual coupling resonators
readingDepth: Publisher abstract and bibliographic metadata read. Full text required subscription and was not read.
claim: A metasurface improves acoustic transmission across an impedance-mismatched air-water interface and supports a harvesting demonstration.
limits: Relative transmission enhancement is not absolute conversion efficiency or evidence of additional energy. Detailed power-budget methods not inspected.

title: Hierarchical piezoelectric metasurface for acoustic energy harvesting and noise mitigation
readingDepth: Search-indexed publisher highlights and summary read; direct publisher HTML/PDF returned access errors. Full text not read.
claim: A porous piezoelectric metasurface combines acoustic attenuation with electrical harvesting; reported optima use different frequencies and sound conditions.
limits: Do not combine peak absorption, insulation and output into one operating point or infer conversion from an open-circuit voltage. Hardware claims unreplicated.

title: A Membrane Magnetoelastic Generator for Acoustic Energy Harvesting
readingDepth: PubMed abstract and figure captions 1-4 read. Indexed PMC abstract inspected; direct full PMC access hit a browser check, so full article not read.
claim: A membrane couples acoustic motion through magnetoelasticity and induction, with load sweeps and capacitor charging reported.
limits: A capacitor's energy gain is measurable, but does not alone give total source efficiency. Source acoustic/electrical budget and smartphone demonstration not independently reproduced.

title: Active-Learning-Guided Acoustic Metamaterial Resonators for Low-Frequency Noise Suppression and Piezoelectric Energy Harvesting
readingDepth: Search-indexed publisher results and PubMed abstract/metadata read. Direct publisher page returned 429 and PDF request failed; full text not read.
claim: A Gaussian-process/active-learning and FEM workflow designs resonant cavities that enhance local pressure and reported piezoelectric output.
limits: Geometry optimization does not create energy. Reported normalization, coupling and experimental performance have not been independently reproduced here.
